explication: quic-go is a pure-Go QUIC implementation with an HTTP/3 layer. The principal workflow is: an application issues or serves an HTTP request, HTTP/3 opens a QUIC connection, QUIC performs TLS-based handshake and packet exchange over UDP, then multiplexed streams deliver the response. The graph also preserves documented datagrams, multipath, congestion/loss recovery, flow control, connection IDs, and qlog observability. Some relationships are inferred from stable package boundaries because sampled excerpts are partial.
